payload.title: Inventory KANBUS_* environment variables and close the Python/Rust gaps
payload.description: Item 6 of kbs-eb1788. Rust reads 70 KANBUS_* names, Python 47. Rust-only: console and cloud auth settings (KANBUS_AUTH_MODE, KANBUS_API_STAGE, KANBUS_CLOUD_*, KANBUS_COGNITO_*, KANBUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, KANBUS_IOT_DATA_ENDPOINT, KANBUS_MQTT_CUSTOM_AUTHORIZER_NAME, KANBUS_TENANT_*_CLAIM_KEY), KANBUS_SNYK_DEBUG, the prefixes KANBUS_REALTIME_ and KANBUS_COORDINATION_, and KANBUS_TEST_* hooks. Python-only: KANBUS_NON_INTERACTIVE, KANBUS_ROUTER_MQTT_DIAGNOSTICS, KANBUS_ENABLE_TEST_HOOKS. Work: document every variable in one table (name, purpose, runtimes, intentional or gap); port user-facing gaps spec-first; list console/server-only and test-hook variables as intentional Rust-only or Python-only; identify variables that only served the retired legacy cloud console (kbs-14a848) for a separate removal task.
